title: OrthoRF: Exploring Orthogonality in Object-Centric Representations
abstract: arXiv:2610.35203v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Neural synchrony is hypothesized to help the brain organize visual scenes into structured multi-object representations. In machine learning, synchrony-based models analogously learn object-centric representations by storing binding in the phase of complex-valued features. Rotating Features (RF) instantiate this idea with vector-valued activations, encoding object presence in magnitudes and affiliation in orientations. We propose Orthogonal Rotating Features (OrthoRF), which enforces orthogonality in RF's orientation space via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications. This yields sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping. In evaluations of unsupervised object discovery, including settings with overlapping objects, noise, and out-of-distribution tests, OrthoRF matches or outperforms current models while producing more interpretable representations, and it eliminates the post-hoc clustering required by many synchrony

translated_title: OrthoRF：探索以对象为中心表示中的正交性
translated_abstract: 神经同步被假设有助于大脑将视觉场景组织成结构化的多对象表示。在机器学习中，基于同步的模型类似地通过将绑定信息存储在复值特征的相位中来学习以对象为中心的表示。旋转特征（RF）用向量值激活来实现这一思想，在幅值中编码对象的存在，在方向中编码归属关系。我们提出正交旋转特征，通过内积损失和架构修改在RF的方向空间中强制正交性。这带来了更清晰的相位对齐和更可靠的分组。在无监督对象发现的评估中，包括重叠对象、噪声和分布外测试等设置，OrthoRF匹配或超越了当前模型，同时产生更可解释的表示，并且它消除了许多同步模型所需的事后聚类步骤。
tldr: OrthoRF通过内积损失和架构修改在旋转特征的方向空间中强制正交性，实现了更清晰的相位对齐和更可靠的对象分组，在无监督对象发现任务中匹配或超越现有模型，同时提供更可解释的表示并消除了事后聚类的需求。
en_tdlr: OrthoRF enforces orthogonality in the orientation space of Rotating Features via an inner-product loss and architectural modifications, achieving sharper phase alignment and more reliable grouping that matches or outperforms current models in unsupervised object discovery while producing more interpretable representations without requiring post-hoc clustering.
